nodes.label: 403 Directory Access Guard (app/index.html)
nodes.rationale: Prevents directory listing of application source files if the web server exposes non-public directories.

nodes.label: 403 Directory Access Guard (tests/index.html)
nodes.rationale: Prevents directory listing of test files if the web server exposes non-public directories.

nodes.label: 403 Directory Access Guard (writable/cache/index.html)
nodes.rationale: Prevents directory listing of cached files if the web server exposes writable subdirectories.

nodes.label: 403 Directory Access Guard (writable/debugbar/index.html)
nodes.rationale: Prevents directory listing of CodeIgniter debugbar snapshots if the web server exposes writable subdirectories.

nodes.label: 403 Directory Access Guard (writable/index.html)
nodes.rationale: Prevents directory listing of writable runtime storage if the web server exposes non-public directories.

nodes.label: 403 Directory Access Guard (writable/logs/index.html)
nodes.rationale: Prevents directory listing of application log files if the web server exposes writable subdirectories.

nodes.label: 403 Directory Access Guard (writable/session/index.html)
nodes.rationale: Prevents directory listing of persisted user session files if the web server exposes writable subdirectories.

nodes.label: 403 Directory Access Guard (writable/uploads/index.html)
nodes.rationale: Prevents directory listing of uploaded files if the web server exposes writable subdirectories.

nodes.label: Public Folder Entry Point (public/index.php)
nodes.rationale: index.php was moved from the project root into the public folder for better security and separation of components; web servers and virtual hosts should point to public/ so framework internals and application logic are not exposed.

nodes.label: PHPUnit XML Configuration (phpunit.xml.dist)
nodes.rationale: Copying phpunit.xml.dist to git-ignored phpunit.xml lets developers customize local test execution such as excluding database tests or generating HTML coverage without modifying the repository default configuration.
